learningObjectives: Explain the physiological or methodological basis of Medication and Substance Effects.
Apply Medication and Substance Effects to technically valid clinical interpretation.
Identify artifacts, confounds and limits that could alter conclusions.
Communicate findings without exceeding the evidence or professional scope.

mechanismMap.label: Core concept
mechanismMap.detail: Sedatives, stimulants, antidepressants, antipsychotics, anticonvulsants, caffeine, alcohol and withdrawal states can alter spectral and epileptiform features.

mechanismMap.label: Mechanism
mechanismMap.detail: Dose, timing, adherence and recent changes should be documented. Medication effects can interact with sleep and diagnosis.

mechanismMap.label: Clinical integration
mechanismMap.detail: Prevents misattribution of pharmacological effects to disorder or intervention.

mechanismMap.label: Boundary condition
mechanismMap.detail: Ignoring medication timing invalidates longitudinal comparison.
